unit: psionic CNN tensor-IR and first-order autodiff core
standing: Focused evaluator checks pass; broader release and authority qualification are not established by this record.

profile.target: CPU only; CUDA and Metal admission explicitly refused
profile.layout: rank-4 NCHW activations and OIHW weights, valid cross-correlation, implicit stride one
profile.compute: sequential f32 multiply/add in input-channel, kernel-row, kernel-column order, persistent per-command finite flags
profile.derivative: formal first-order f64 VJP over stored f32 operands; both input and weight gradients; signed-stride view/root mapping retained
profile.unsupported: Compiled-backward and graph-function transforms explicitly refuse convolution until their derivative rules are implemented.

compiler.scope: Parent supplied the retained binary and explicitly prohibited rebuilding it. Compiler errors additionally print a stale-source advisory because its source worktree changed. This record does not qualify the compiler or clear its inherited unchanged mutation survivor.

check_first.observed_red: New CNN checks referenced TiOp.conv2d before implementation: missing enum-member diagnostics.
New graph-function convolution refusal assertion failed before the fx_program eligibility guard was added.

runs.command: /tmp/openagents-psionic-framework-20261101/coax/bin/coax test psionic/lib/compiled-backward.coax --only 'compiled gradients equal the tape' --run-steps 250000000 --evidence /tmp/cnn-core-20261101/baseline-compiled.json

coverage: Eight focused core checks pass in checked and release evaluator modes.
Asymmetric rectangular kernels; N=2, Cin=2, Cout=2 exact rational oracle for every forward output and every operand gradient, including each single-operand mode.
Negative-stride activation and weight views, physical root gradient maps, actual saved material values and opposite-operand backward lifetimes.
A derivative contribution smaller than binary32 spacing survives in the f64 formal VJP.
Product overflow and accumulation overflow persist through later ReLU and copy; publishing refuses while preserving caller output.
Rank, channel, kernel extent, dependency, device, dtype, budget and work-limit refusal; stable existing command tags and lowering layout.
Compiled backward explicitly refuses both gradient-enabled and forward-only convolution programs.
One additional graph-function refusal check passes in checked and release evaluator modes for leaf orders zero through two and an unused convolution node.
Five existing selected smoke checks pass: tensor-IR shape inference, dense-Jacobian autodiff, kernel flag storage, compiled/tape gradient parity, graph-function layout.
omissions: All tests used --only. Dependency checks and authority execution coverage are not checked by these commands; compiler evidence verdicts intentionally remain not-checked.
No mutation run, compiler rebuild or full legacy gate was run, following the explicit owner task scope.
Coax test executes in its evaluator, not generated native code. Native CNN/oracle experiments are maintained separately by the parent task; this record makes no native execution claim.
No GPU convolution, padding or dilation, general strides, pooling, compiled convolution derivative, higher-order convolution transform, dataset learning or product-quality claim follows.

consumer_audit.finding: The graph-function tangent and cross-curvature rules omitted convolution and previously would silently return zero after generic IR admission. fx_program now returns FxStatus.operation for every convolution graph.
consumer_audit.other_paths: Compiled trainer uses cb_compile and its explicit refusal. Eager/module training uses the new ad_rule. Tensor templates preserve nodes and use ti_compile. The host reference maps convolution through ti_request to existing ToOp.conv2d.
